cases.name: Janet Jones Luxford
cases.about:
“She was a great woman,’’ her daughter Amanda Luxford Fernandez said. “She was sweet, she had a southern drawl and she loved country music. Reba McEntire had always been her idol.” “She loved with everything she had,’’ she said. Luxford had struggled with drug use in her past, and Fernandez believes the drug use resurfaced when Jones came into the picture. “She was always a great mom,’’ she said. “She never put anything before her children until this man came along.”

https://www.al.com/news/2022/04/woman-whose-mother-was-found-dead-in-suitcase-21-years-after-her-alabama-murder-hopes-for-justice-i-lost-everything-of-my-childhood.html
cases.narrative: On 3/27/2022 he confessed to her murder and led police to her remains in a green suitcase in a rural wooded area near Harmer Street and Valley Creek in Jefferson County.
